question.text: Unlike Operating Expenses, TRANSACTION EXPENSES (deal due-diligence, travel, stamp duty on secondary purchases, etc.) of a Cat I/II AIF are charged on what basis?

answer.text: Subject to the same 10-50 bps annual cap as operating expenses
Fully absorbed by the Investment Manager (zero pass-through)
On actuals, without any cap, allocated pro-rata across classes of units
Payable only from Carry proceeds at fund wind-up

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 6: transaction expenses are borne by the fund ON ACTUALS, WITHOUT LIMITS, and allocated pro-rata across classes of units on the basis of capital contributions or NAV. They cover deal origination, diligence, travel, custodian fees, stamp duty on secondary purchases, certifications. The Trap: A confuses transaction with operating expenses; C is LP-friendly wishful thinking; D confuses treatment with waterfall. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C covers this. SEBI does not prescribe a transaction-expense cap; LPs negotiate bilaterally.
